newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche founds vitamin B6 venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Roche founds vitamin B6 venture in China.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Roche Holding AG said it and Shanghai New Asiatic Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd had founded a joint-venture to produce Vitamin B6.

Roche said in a statement that the agreement to found Roche New Asiatic (Shanghai) Vitamins Ltd. was signed today and was part of the company's strategy of cooperating closely with local companies to develop the Chinese market.

The venture is 60 percent owned by Roche and 40 percent by Shanghai New Asiatic Pharmaceuticals, one of the 100 largest pharmaceutical companies in China, which produces more than 50 different products.
The venture will produce an annual output of some 1,000 tonnes of Vitamin B6.
Investments of $29.6 million will mainly be used to modernise the vitamin production facilities in the Shanghai Pudong New Development Zone.
